mapper.select: SELECT d.iot_id, p.third_platform, d.product_key, d.device_id, d.ext_device_id, d.device_name, d.product_name, p.photo_url AS product_image, d.coordinate, p.device_node AS device_type, p.device_node, CASE WHEN d.state = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS online_status, to_timestamp(d.online_time) AS last_online_time, d.gw_product_key, d.device_tag, d.device_address, d.ext1, d.ext2, d.ext3, d.ext4 FROM iot_device d LEFT JOIN iot_product p ON d.product_key = p.product_key WHERE d.application = #{linkedAppId} ORDER BY d.create_time DESC

SELECT d.iot_id, p.third_platform, d.product_key, d.device_id, d.ext_device_id, d.device_name, d.product_name, p.photo_url AS product_image, d.coordinate, p.device_node AS device_type, p.device_node, CASE WHEN d.state = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS online_status, to_timestamp(d.online_time) AS last_online_time, d.gw_product_key, d.device_tag, d.device_address, d.configuration, p.metadata, to_timestamp(d.create_time) AS create_time, d.ext1, d.ext2, d.ext3, d.ext4 FROM iot_device d LEFT JOIN iot_product p ON d.product_key = p.product_key WHERE d.iot_id = #{iotId} LIMIT 1

SELECT d.iot_id, p.third_platform, d.product_key, d.device_id, d.ext_device_id, d.device_name, d.product_name, p.photo_url AS product_image, d.coordinate, p.device_node AS device_type, p.device_node, CASE WHEN d.state = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS online_status, to_timestamp(d.online_time) AS last_online_time, d.gw_product_key, d.device_tag, d.device_address, d.configuration, d.ext1, d.ext2, d.ext3, d.ext4 FROM iot_device d LEFT JOIN iot_product p ON d.product_key = p.product_key WHERE d.gw_product_key = #{productKey} AND d.ext_device_id = #{deviceId} ORDER BY d.create_time ASC
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM iot_device WHERE application = #{linkedAppId} AND state = 1
